periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation directed anterior-medially toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid shape with the longitudinal axis approximately double the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Clear tapering effect visible at the anterior margin of the patch as it nears the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape with a slight anterior indentation at the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies approximately 30% of the visible torso length, tapering slightly as it descends toward the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Distinct gap between ears, measuring roughly 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded convex curves along the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Notable yellowish-brown tinting present on the white fur of the dorsal midline and interscapular region.
